measurements.particle_name: remaining nanoplastic particles in PP-bottle injection solution filtrate

conditions.medium_text: filtrate after the injection solution was filtered through a GF-B membrane (Φ = 1 μm)

measurements.evidence_quote: The zeta potential of the filtrate after the injection solution was filtered through a GF-B membrane (Φ = 1 μm) was -3.41 mV, which was the potential of the remaining nanoplastic particles (Table S1; Figure S5).

conditions.medium_text: the injection solution dispersed with the 500 nm PP particles after filtration through an Al2O3 membrane with a pore size of 20 nm

measurements.evidence_quote: The spherical PP particles used in this study had a surface area of 0.283 μm2 and a zeta potential of -3.15 mV (the injection solution dispersed with the 500 nm PP particles after filtration through an Al2O3 membrane with a pore size of 20 nm).
